items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Is that composed by Amos White?

ctx.x: I played with, in fact, Houston there, but I played at the country club with Percy. I played.

Oh yeah, this is that homemade record. Oh yes, I'd like to hear this. Is that composed by Amos White? Yeah. Yeah. I was wondering some more about the Louis Dumaine records. Do you remember just where they were made?

Yeah, yeah. We made it somewhere down on Rampart Street. On Rampart Street. Yeah. And Pretty Audrey, I know that was one of the songs, Pretty Audrey. Yes. And uh, Franklin Street Blues. But I didn't play it on that record. That girl woman sing on that record. That woman sing on that record. That was one of Ann Cooke's. Yeah, yeah, yeah. You did. Yeah, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. You made those too. I played sax on the other day. I played sax, yeah. Yeah, yeah. I played sax. I played sax, yeah. Yeah, I played sax. Uh-huh.…
